A Play, a Pie and a Pint presents an interesting – and impressively polished – hip-hop musical about the life and legacy of William Wallace

This week’s A Play, A Pie, A Pint, written by Rob Drummond and Dave Hook , brings us a slick and thought-provoking hip-hop musical comedy with the life (or myth) of 13th-century Scottish legend and freedom fighter William Wallace at the centre of its conversation.
